name: Evolution St. Louis
old_description: Evolution St. Louis - the premier high-tech knitting facility using cutting-edge 3D and complete garment seamless knitting technology - is creating the manufacturing facility and supply chain of the future. We revitalize the knit industry, allow American brands and retailers to keep pace with emerging trends, and make St. Louis the industry sector for advanced knitting and manufacturing.
about:
Evolution St. Louis operates a high-tech knitting facility in St. Louis, Missouri. The company builds on the city’s deep fashion-industry heritage to create what it calls the apparel manufacturing and supply chain facility of the future, focusing on advanced flat-bed knitting technology and the creation of new U.S. manufacturing jobs.

The facility runs industry-leading STOLL ADF and CMS knit and wear® machines capable of 3D and complete-garment seamless knitting. It produces fully fashioned knits, sweaters knit to shape, footwear, smart textiles, and technical textiles, achieving complex geometries with minimal waste. Services include product engineering, prototyping, material sourcing and development, technology integration, IP protection, and testing, with small-batch runs enabled by short setup times. Linking, sewing, finishing, labeling, barcoding, and hangtag application are also offered in-house.

The company serves brands and retailers across apparel, footwear, accessories, technical and smart textiles, automotive, aerospace, home and furniture, lifestyle, sports, health and wellness, medical technology, and public-safety sectors such as medical, police, fire, and transit.

Evolution St. Louis was started to revitalize the domestic knit industry, allowing American brands to keep pace with emerging trends and positioning St. Louis as a hub for advanced knitting and manufacturing.
